title: He is God…
paragraphs:
He is God…
So why is He crying like He’s about to break?
And why does heaven feel… silent?
Because this moment will expose something most of us spend our lives hiding.

Not the miracle-working Jesus.
Not the storm-rebuking Jesus.

If He is God…
why is He begging?

If He has all power…
why does He look so weak?
In the garden, Jesus isn’t just facing pain.
He’s facing the full weight of sin—yours, mine, the ones we hide, the ones we justify, the ones we renamed so they don’t sound so bad.
“Being in anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood…” (Luke 22:44)
This is pressure so intense, the body starts breaking.
What do you do when pressure hits?
Because some of us don’t fall into sin suddenly.
We entertain thoughts we’d never say out loud.
We keep showing up at church… but slowly stop surrendering in private.

You don’t need darkness to betray Jesus.
Sometimes… all it takes is silence.
Judas didn’t fall in a moment.
That’s the tension in the image you saw.
And maybe… that’s you right now.
But you’re not fully surrendered either.
But something inside you is resisting.

Jesus didn’t pray because He lacked power.
He prayed because surrender is the pathway to victory.
“Not My will, but Yours be done.” (Matthew 26:39)
The cup Jesus was asking about?
The justice of God against sin.
And instead of giving that cup to you…
2 Corinthians 5:21 says, “God made Him who knew no sin to be sin for us…”
Every moment you chose yourself over God…
This is where religion gets exposed.
You were never strong enough. That’s why He came.
If your faith has never cost you surrender… it may only be performance.
Because the story doesn’t end in the garden.
So your sin could be forgiven.
So your life could be made new.
You are not the person your secret sin is trying to define.
You are not the version of yourself that keeps failing.
But transformation begins where Jesus stood.
What are you still holding back from God?
What “cup” are you refusing to surrender?
You just need an honest heart.
And if something in you is waking up right now…
We’re exposing the moment Peter said “I’ll never deny You”… and why most believers are closer to that fall than they think.
